A Study of Psilocybin for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
mappingAssertions.rationale: NCT03866174 is associated with a Usona Institute–reported psilocybin-in-major-depressive-disorder programme candidate. Psilocybin, Niacin, and Set and Setting (SaS) Protocol remain separate registry-reported interventions, and their precise programme roles remain unknown.
mappingAssertions.reviewerReference: Keith Grehan — explicit human review decision in the S1-04 Codex task
mappingAssertions.reviewRationale: Approved as a human-reviewed association of NCT03866174 with a Usona Institute–reported psilocybin-in-major-depressive-disorder programme candidate. ClinicalTrials.gov names Psilocybin in the study title, reports Usona Institute as lead sponsor organisation, and reports Depressive Disorder, Major. Niacin and Set and Setting (SaS) Protocol remain separately preserved registry interventions. This approval does not assert that psilocybin is the only intervention, or establish company identity, ownership, developer status, commercial rights, programme-level phase/status, mechanism, efficacy, or safety.

mappingAssertions.reviewRationale: Approved as a human-reviewed association within NCT05711940: the ClinicalTrials.gov title names COMP360, the intervention field reports Psilocybin, the lead sponsor organisation is COMPASS Pathways, and the condition is Treatment Resistant Depression. This does not establish that COMP360 and Psilocybin are synonyms or chemically/formulation-equivalent, nor company identity, ownership, developer status, commercial rights, programme-level phase/status, efficacy, or safety.

mappingAssertions.reviewRationale: Approved as an evidence-bounded human-inference mapping: ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT06605105 names CYB003 in the study title, reports CYB003 as its sole intervention, Major Depressive Disorder as the condition, and Cybin IRL Limited as the lead sponsor organisation. This approval links the study to the programme candidate ‘CYB003 for major depressive disorder’ and candidate compound label ‘CYB003’ only. It does not establish chemical identity, company identity, ownership, developer or commercial-rights status, programme-wide phase/status, mechanism, efficacy, safety, or superiority.
